Anya (PM): Quick sync — launch numbers came in. Crash rate 0.6% (acceptable) but discoverability bug B-1 is high-signal. Need to decide mini-sprint scope: prioritize bugs or ship 2 customer-requested enh? I propose: target next 2-week mini-sprint = fix top 5 bugs + one small enhancement (embeddings prefetch). Thoughts?
Sanjay: I lean bugs-first, but top 5 includes 2 medium infra regressions needing infra time. Could we do: 3 high-sev bugs + 2 small UX enhancements?
Leo: Agree with Sanjay. Also can we triage which bugs are customer-facing vs backend? If backend infra, maybe schedule for Dedicated infra slot.
Megan: From support, customers are asking for the UX tweak (ENH-42) and clearer error messages. That second one is low-effort and helps perception.
Anya (PM): Good point. Let's make decision criteria: customer-impact, regression windows, QA cost, and rollout risk.
Ivy (Eng): Dev estimate: top 5 bugs = 20 dev-days, UX tweak = 3 dev-days. We have ~15 dev-days capacity in next mini-sprint.
QA Bot: nightly-ci: streaming-path flaky -> 12% fail rate (last 7 runs). See: https://ci.internal/runs/1234
Anya (PM): Given capacity, propose: Sprint-1 (2 weeks) = 3 customer-facing bugs (B1,B3,B7) + 1 low-effort enhancement (ENH-42). Remaining bugs added to "nextwave" backlog with canary rollout plan.
Sanjay: ack. I'll pick up B3 and hand off B7 to Ivy.
Ivy (Eng): ack, will triage B7 tonight; will check streaming flakiness tests and paste logs in #eng-oncall if needed.
Megan: I'll draft customer communication and update support KB with workaround for B1.
Anya (PM): Action items: 1) Sanjay owner B3, 2) Ivy owner B7 + investigate QA Bot failure, 3) Leo to confirm deployment window (prefer Tue evening), 4) Megan to draft KB. We'll groom acceptance criteria tomorrow 10:00am. If no objections, locking scope. :thumbsup:
Leo: fine from infra side. Tue evening deploy window OK.
Sanjay: :+1:
Megan: :raised_hands:
Anya (PM): Locking scope in 24h unless someone raises a blocker.
